summary: SiteDocument is a data structure representing documents associated with specific sites in the HSPnet system. It is closely tied to the SiteID and contains basic identification fields.
purpose: To model and facilitate storage and retrieval of documents per site for business processes requiring site-specific information or documentation.

fields.name: ID
fields.description: Unique identifier for the site document

fields.name: SiteID
fields.description: Unique identifier for the site to which the document is linked

summary: WelcomeStaffAdmin is a UI page that facilitates displaying and filtering employment applications and staff-related data, with site and discipline filters, error/warning panels, and date validators. The UI uses update panels, grid views, dropdown lists, and validation controls for interaction.
purpose: To allow staff administrators to view, filter, and manage employment applications for students by site, discipline, date range, and withdrawn status, while providing error and warning feedback.

workflows.name: Filter Employment Applications
steps: Select Site, Discipline, and date range
View details, email, and status of applications

business_rules: StartDate and EndDate must be valid and StartDate must be before EndDate.
Withdrawn applications are shown or hidden based on checkbox.
Required fields and formats are enforced.
system_behavior: On page load, prefill dropdowns, dates, and last login.
Grid view is updated asynchronously on filter change or refresh.
exceptions: Error and warning panels appear for screen and validation errors.
content_gaps: Underlying business logic for EmploymentApplication entity is not fully described.
UI field definitions are somewhat fragmented.

summary: ServiceCode is a model for categorization and identification of services, allowing multilingual fields and associated properties. ServiceCodes manages lists and offers search for service codes by course or timetable.
purpose: To enable lookup, localization, and categorization of service codes for business processes such as scheduling and reporting.

workflows.name: Retrieve Service Codes
steps: Call ServiceCodes static method with session context

business_rules: Localization uses alternative language fields if enabled.
conditions: Session.UseAltLanguageFields determines which fields are returned.
system_behavior: Returns lists of ServiceCodes based on CourseID, TimetableID, or all
content_gaps: No description of UI usage or actor interaction.

summary: SiteProfileHistory records changes and actions performed on site profiles, including user details, agency information, date of action, and multilingual fields. It supports search and display, and provides formatted user info and tooltips for auditing.
purpose: To provide auditing and historical tracking of changes made to site profiles, including who made them, what fields were changed, and on what date, for compliance and traceability.
business_rules: Alt language fields used if session requires it.
SysAdmin and user/agency identifiers are used for display/tooltip logic.
system_behavior: Returns SiteProfileHistory entries formatted for auditing or UI display.
content_gaps: Underlying SQL and UI display details are not fully shown.

summary: EmailPopupDocument models and manages emails-as-files, including filename, file path, and checked status. EmailPopupDocuments supports searching and deleting email files, managing related folders and file system actions.
purpose: To enable storage, retrieval, listing, and deletion of email documents in popup UI contexts, linked to files and folders.

workflows.name: Search Email Popup Documents
steps: Call static Search with DataInfo string

workflows.name: Delete Email Popup Document
steps: Call static Delete with DataInfo and ID

business_rules: Delete Email should delete both file and folder if found.
Checked property is used for UI selection.
conditions: Only delete files/folders if paths exist.
system_behavior: Deletes files and folders from filesystem.
exceptions: Try-catch block for file/folder deletion failures.
content_gaps: UI and user interaction details are missing.
How Checked property is set/used is not explicitly described.
